query: How can progressive shelter failure modes (fan-only, reduced ventilation) be parametrised and linked to indoor temperature thresholds?

response.query: How can progressive shelter failure modes (fan-only, reduced ventilation) be parametrised and linked to indoor temperature thresholds?
response.answer: Progressive shelter failure modes can be linked to indoor temperature thresholds by establishing specific temperature limits that trigger ventilation or cooling interventions. Fan-only and reduced ventilation modes are activated when indoor temperatures exceed predefined thresholds to prevent overheating.
